decisions.reason: High investment in a multi-model line and public page commitment lead management to persist despite any ambiguous results.
As a variant line close to core products, its sunk costs and visible launch justify continued keeping.
Though less extensive than the variant lines, its public presentation and fit with established burnout fabrics make dropping unlikely.
Building on established upholstery fabrics with a dedicated page signals commitment that management will defend.
Even if results are mixed, its functional niche within the existing range and sunk investments favor persistence.
The satin lining extends the firm's offer and any weakness can be attributed to temporary causes, so management will continue it.
